m: स्वोचित mfn. suitable to o˚'s self, Kathās.; Rājat.; Daś., Sch.

v: tri॰ svena upArjitam । svayamarjite DanAdO । tasya viBAgo dAyaBAge darSito yaTA “samprati vimAjyamaviBAjyaYcocyate । tatra kAtyAyanaH “pEtAmahaYca pitryaYca yaccAnyat svayamarjitam । dAyAdAnAM viBAge tu savaMmetadviBajyate” । “yaccAnyaditi cakAraH svayamityanena saMbaDyate svayaYcArjitamiti cakArAdyanya syApi tadarjanaM sADAraRaDanadvAreRetyarTaH । anupaGAtopAttamuviBAjyamAhaturmanuvizRU “anupaGnan pitfdravyaM SrameRa yadupArjayet । svayamIhitalabDaM tannAkAmo dAtumarhati” । pitfdravyopaGAtABAvena dravyadvAreRa netarezAM vyApAraH, svacezwAlabDatvena SArIro'pi vyApAro netarezAmiti arjakasyEva tadasADAraRaM svayamIhitalabDaM taditi hetutvenopanyAsAt । taTA ca vyAsaH “anASritya pitfdravyaM svaSaktyApnoti, yadDanam । dAyAdeByI na taddadyAdvidyAlabDantu yadBavet” । svaSaktimAtreRa yat prAptamiti sAmAnyenABiDAnAt sarvamevaMviDaM svIyamasADAraRaM drazwavyam । svaSaktiprAptasyApi vidyADanasya samADikavidyEH sADAraRatvAt nyUnavidyAvidyanirAkaraRArTaM vidyAlabDa padam । taTA yAjYavalkyaH “pitfdravyAviroDena yada nyat svayamarjitam । mEtramOdvAhikaYcEva dAyAdAnAM na tadBavet” । mEtrAdigrahaRaM pradarSanArTaM, evamAdizu prAyeRAnupaGAtasamBavAt । taTA manuH “vidyADanantu yadyasya tattasyEva DanaM Bavet । mEtramOdvAhikaYcEva mADuparkikameva ca” । taTA vyAsaH “vidyAprAptaM SOryyaDanaM yacca sOdAyikaM Bavet । viBAgakAle tattasya nAnvezwavyaM svarikTiBiH” । pitfpitfvyAdiByaH sudAyasasambanDiByaH prasAdAdinA labDaM sOdAyikam । taTA nAradaH “SOryyaBAryyADane, hitvA, yacca vidyADanaM Bavet trIRyetAnyaviBAjyAni prasAdo yaSca zEtfkaH” । BAryyAprAptikAle labDaM BAryyADanam OdvAhikamityarTaH, etAni varjayitvA anyadviBajedityanuvarttate vAkyAntarIyam । tadavamAdiBiH SOryyAdiDanatvamaviBAjyatve kAraRaM nocyate SOryyAdyarjitasyAvi viBAgaSruteH । taTA ca vyAsaH “sADAraRaM samASritya yat kiYcidvAhanAyuDam । SOryyAdinApnoti DanaM BrAtarastatra BAginaH । tasya BAgadvayaM deyaM SezAstu samaBAginaH । sADAraRadravyeRArjitasya Danasya viBAgaM vadati । taTA nAradaH “kuwumbaM viBfyAd BrAturyo vidyAmaDigacCataH । BAgaM vidyADanAttasmAt sa laBetASruto'pi san” । viBfyAdityekavacananirdeSAt yawi vidyAmaByasyato BrAtuH kuwumbamaparo BrAtA svaDanavyayaSarIrAyAsAByAM saMvardDayati tadA tadvidyopArjitaDane tasyApyaDikAraH । taTA “vEdyo'vidyAya nAkAmo dadyAdaMSaM svato DanAt । pitryaM dravyaM samASritya na cettena tadarjitam” । patrapadaM sADAraRaGanaparaM tadanASrityArjitaM vEdyo'vidyAya anicCanna dadyAt vEdyAya viduze punaH sADAraRamantareRApyarjitaM dadyAdeva । taTA ca gOtamaH “svayamarjitamavEdyeByo vEdyaH kAmaM na dadyAt” । asADAraRaDanaSarIravyApArArjitaM svayamarjitaM avidvadByo dAtumanacCin na dadyAt vidvadByaH punardadyAdeva । etacca vidyADanamAtravizayam । tadAha kAtyAyanaH “nAvidyAnAntu vEdyena deyaM vidyADanaM kvacit । samavidyADikAnAntu deyaM vEdyena tadDanam” । tantroccaritavidyApadam uBAByAM samADikapadAByAM saMbaDyate tena samavidyADikavidyAnAM dAtavyaM nyUnavidyAvidyayoH punaranaDikAraH । “tadevamAdivanErvidyASOryyAdiDanezvapi sADAraRaDanopaGAtAnupaGAtAByAM viBAgAviBAgayoravagamAt tasyEva prayojakatvAt tatpadavatyeva SrutiH kalpanIyAupaGAtaHrjitaM viBajediti, na punaH SOryyAdipadavatyapi, avaSyakalpanIyasAmAnyaSrutikalpanayEvopapatteH । holAkADikaraRanyAyasyAyameva vizayaH । yadvA nyAyaprApta evAyamarTaH, yadyenArjitaM tat tasmin jIvati tasyEva, asati viSezavacane, yatra punaH sADAraRaDanamAtreREkasya vyApAro'parasya DanaSarIrAByAM tatrEkasyEko BAgo'parasya BAgadvayaM nyAyAvagatamevaM sidDam । etena cEtadapi siDyati, yat sADAraRaDanopaGAte sati yasya yAvato'MSasya svalpasya mahatovopaGAtaH, tasya tadanusAreRa BAgakalpanA kAryyA । kiYca kAtyAyanavacanam “viBaktAH pitfvittAccedekatra prativAsinaH । viBajeyuH punadrvyaMSaM salaBetodayo yataH” । iti SrItArAnATatarkavAcaspatiBawwAcAryyasaNkalite vAcaspatye sakArAdiSabdArTasaNkalanam ।
m: स्वोपार्जित mfn. self-acquired, Dāyat.

s: tri, (svenopArjjitaH .) svayamarjjitaH । svayamupAttaH । yaTA, pitA cet puttrAn viBajet tasya svecCA svayamupAtte'rTe pattAmahe tu pitAputtrayAstulyaM svAmitvam । iti vizRusUtram । api ca । manuvizRU । “patfkantu pitA dravyamanavAptaM yadApnuyAt । na tat puttrErBajet sArdDamakAmaH svayamarjitam ॥” tat svayamarjitamiti kftvA na viBajedityanvayaH । etattu sTAvaravizayam । maRyAdAvanudDfte'pi pitureva svAcCandyam । “sTAvaraM dvipadaYcEva yadyapi svayamarjitam । tasamBUya sutAn sarvvAn na dAnaM na ca vikrayaH ॥ pituH prasAdAt Bujyante vastrARyABaraRAni ca । sTAvarantu na Bujyeta prasAde sati patfke ॥” iti mitAkzarADftavacanamapi pitAmahaDana param । pitrA ca svopArjitaM sTAvaraM dattaM Bujyata eveti । anyaTA mUlaBUtaSrutyantarakalpanApattaH । iti dAyatattvam ॥ * ॥ svApArjitaM dviviDam । pitrAdaDanAdyupaDAtena svenopArjitam । tadanupaGAtena upArjitaYca । tadDanaviBAgaviDiryaTA । vyAsaH । “anASritya pitfdravyaM svaSaktyApnoti yadDanam । dAyAdaByo na taddadyAt vidyAlabDaYca yadBavet ॥” kAtyAyanaH । “dvyaMSaharo'rdDaharo vA puttravittArjanAt pitA .” puttravittArjanAt । kfdvihito BAvA dravyavat prakASate iti nyyayAt puttrArjitAvattAt piturdvyaMSitvaM pitfDanAnupaGAtavizayaM BrAtfDanopaGAtaviMzayaYca । arjakasya tu dvyaMSitvam । BrAtfDanopaGAte tu tezAmapyekAMSitvaM vakzyamARavacanAt । piturardvaharatvantu pitfdravyopaGAtAdguRavattvAdvA iti dAyaBAgaH ॥ anupaGAte pitA dvyaMSaharaH । arjakatvAt svayamapi dvyaMSaharaH । itarezAmanaMSitvam । BrAtfdravyopaGAte tu tezAmapyekAMSaH । iti dbyaMSArdDAMSayorBedakaTanam ॥ * ॥ sADAraRaDanArjite'pi viSezamAha vyAsaH । “sADAraRaM samASritya yatkiYcit vahanAyuDam । SOryyAdinApnoti DanaM BrAtarastatra BAginaH । tasya BAgadvayaM deyaM SezAstu samaBAginaH ॥” atra BrAtara ityupalakzaRaM pitfvyAdayo'pi bodDavyAH । tasyArjakasya । sADAraRopaGAte yasya yAvato'MSasTAlpasya mahato vA upaGAtastasya tadanusAreRa BAgakalpanA kAryyA । iti dAyaBAgaH ॥ iti ca dAyatattvam ॥
